title: Chapter 3 review: Climate and questions
body: Back-filled some vocab for weather and climate that were missed earlier. Also added in cuál/qué/quién words that were in that chapter and now we can question everything.

title: The Barrio
body: Added vocabulary for cities and neighborhoods. You can find them in the new 'barrio' section of the dictionary.

title: Direct object pronouns
body: Sentences now practice *lo, la, los* and *las*: ¿Compras el pan? Sí, lo compro.
